changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Populate menu_master_id for existing menus - group by menu_structure_id and version
changeSet.sql: -- Update menus that have the same menu_structure_id to share the same menu_master_id -- For each menu_structure_id, we'll use the ID of the first menu as the menu_master_id UPDATE menu SET menu_master_id = ( SELECT m2.id FROM menu m2 WHERE m2.menu_structure_id = menu.menu_structure_id AND m2.menu_structure_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m2.created_at ASC, m2.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE menu.menu_structure_id IS NOT NULL AND menu.menu_master_id IS NULL;

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Populate menu_master_id for menus without menu_structure_id - each gets its own master ID
changeSet.sql: -- For menus without menu_structure_id, set their own ID as menu_master_id UPDATE menu SET menu_master_id = id WHERE menu_structure_id IS NULL AND menu_master_id IS NULL;
